'''''The Stone Heart''''' was a modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that operated in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the owner of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] made weapons upgrades to the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] without a permit, the freighter was impounded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] of the [[Derilyn Space Defense Platform]], in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]].
